meta.title: Harmony Estates
meta.description: Harmony Estates: HOA Simulator puts you in charge of the neighborhood and gives you the power to become its greatest president or its worst nightmare.

content.name: Run the HOA
content.description: Set neighborhood rules, collect dues, issue citations, and decide what kind of HOA president you want to be.

content.name: Choose Your Path
content.description: Build your reputation through integrity or corruption, with choices that can lead from community hero to ruthless tyrant.

content.name: Live With the Consequences
content.description: Deal with lawsuits, elections, crime, jail, and unpredictable neighbors as every decision shapes the neighborhood around you..
